about_the_game:
Free DEMO will be released on May 25th! 

Reframe

Reframe is an RPG about life and something that's always there with you. You can't run away from it, you can't reason with it, and you can't live with it.

You are a tiny little nobody named Ilya, a first-year college student with no future, no past and no present. One fateful night, the world you thought you knew well, began to shatter. Now you'll have no choice but to press forward and find out what the hell is going on. Will you come out on top or will you succumb further into the sweet joy of comfort?

Features

Explore the town of Chertanovsk, learn about its various inhabitants and mysteries! 

  • No game over screen. If you fail in a battle, you'll have to deal with the consequences. Ranging from getting items/money/pants stolen to entire quests failing as a result! On the other hand, winning may give you special rewards that can unlock secret areas!

  • Chat with 50+ unique characters!

  • Experience day/night cycle with different activities for each time of day.

  • Fight the bad guys! Gopniks, Hipsters, Alcoholics and even Robots!

  • Level up! With 25 abilities to unlock, including 5 secret ones, you'll have plenty of room to experiment with your playstyle!

  • Improve your strength by going to the gym!

  • Improve your perception by going biking, snowboarding, attending classes or shooting some bottles in the forest!

  • Destroy your health by drinking soda and eating chips! But it helps with Energy and Sanity, so maybe it's worth it?

  • Pet a cat named Barsik! There are at least 3... No, wait, 4 cats in this game! Hold on, does this one even count?.. I'm not sure. You can only pet one, but it's just a demo, you know? I can promise that in the full release, you'll be able to pet at least 2 different cats! 

  • Date weird girls! Or die trying.

  • Commit crimes!

  • Join the Club of Warriors!

  • Attend classes like a total nerd!

  • Made almost entirely by one person.

  • Or do none of the above! It's (sort of) open world! So do whatever you want whenever you want.

And don't worry. She will always be watching you.

highlighted.name: I'm Something of a Magician Myself

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains depictions/references to depression, anxiety, suicide. It also contains cartoon violence, occasional blood, references to illegal drugs, alcohol and tobacco use. It also contains bright flashing imagery that may cause discomfort and/or seizures for those with photosensitive epilepsy.
